Verified success permits conditional advance without repeated step approvals; distinct step clocks remain clipped to the immutable parent. Stop on failure, Unknown, input drift or budget exhaustion, with no automatic retry or renewed clock. Only closed verified derivations can feed later steps. Prove actual engine graphroot/runroot/temp/output/process isolation; original outcomes and old holds remain separate from current metadata. Early real credential/policy/workflow/runtime preflight and typed observations remain substantive. Runner, bake, registration and first consumer retain priority. Reusable builder and desktop preparation and source-bound artifact handoff do not establish native qualification. Source delivery and installed instruction/caller adoption stay distinct. Public coordination returns https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398426496 and https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398854743 record two completed finite source-delivery envelopes using the receiver owner existing capabilities: each retained a single apply, exact source and native readback, independent original-scope retirement and its original clock. These observations demonstrate the source-delivery path only; no native engine/bake/consumer acceptance or general economic saving follows. Restricted raw evidence remains in owner custody.

Review the smallest complete real runtime prefix before assembling every bake member. A changed engine mode must propagate through actual member argv/cgroup parent, callback arguments and namespace/pause proof consumers; constructor controls alone missed those couplings in the public review disposition https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398899828. The subsequent initialization-only source return and review https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6399239792 retain a separate external-wrapper/original-clock/cold-observer prerequisite. An internal clock minted after outer setup is not one shared original; every descendant phase must fit the selected parent, with enough bounded retirement and independent collection time. Source, callback tuple witnesses, actual callback settlement and native cleanup are distinct evidence. A later empty scope is current observation, not proof of independent retirement inside a missed original window. The public metadata disposition https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6399286740 preserves that gap without replaying a read-only original or making it a global hold on demonstrated-independent fresh work.

Production diagnostic producers belong in early real-path controls. The repository-owned coordination/c2-public-failure-counterpart-retention record describes the closed actual owner-receipt census and producer-driven retention control. The selected BAR repair restored a complete diagnostic tuple in subsequent failed hosted qualification, while the client emitted no explanatory compiler detail. The original timeout and later nonzero client/owned-descendant refusal are separate failures; restored reporting and cleanup do not establish the compiler cause, model success or retry eligibility. A provider command has its own original clock, independently of earlier canonical work. Preserve required failed gates, no unchanged retry/budget increase or ownership waiver; investigate actual emitted evidence. These are correctness and delegation observations, not measured token savings.

The first genuine private initialization in https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6400020515 succeeded internally but failed whole retirement: one batched stop named an already-collected controller scope and prevented still-loaded owned units/files from retiring. Authenticate complete cold absence separately and stop each remaining exact original unit individually; retain every actual stop failure rather than making a disappearing unit a generic retry. Source constructor controls and two successful internal collections did not establish whole retirement.

Current-manager observations need property applicability, not synthetic defaults. The first two exact cleanup helpers refused before old-remnant effects because an unconfigured worker had no rendered ExecStopPost property. The actual --all query still omitted it, correcting an earlier unchecked explicit-empty claim: https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6400280538. Standing-authorized bounded diagnostics then supplied actual worker, configured guard, slice, gone scope and not-found service shapes in https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6400326327. Require determining service PID/result fields and the actual command outcome for the loaded configured guard; do not demand a nonexistent command from an unconfigured or not-found service. Validate production readers against unchanged actual responses and causal missing-fact controls. A constructed fixture proves parser behavior only. Source shape corrections and consumed failed originals remain distinct; no automatic replay follows.

The subsequent closed sequence https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6400360110 admitted demonstrably independent fresh private initialization first, then exact old-remnant retirement only after verified first-step success. Empty old groups, gone captured actors and disjoint paths/units provided the relevant isolation facts; retained Unknown history did not become a global gate. The scoped acceptance https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6400467943 independently verified both actual originals: fresh controller9.427seconds with two collections, authenticated namespace/guard/fence and eight captured actors independently retired; old-remnant controller0.712seconds with exactly three individual stops, three authenticated file removals and reload. The complete237.834second sequence stayed inside its original900 ceiling, with separate unchanged300second step clocks, no overlap, intermediate approval or retry. The sequence reservation was disclosed as an operator envelope rather than a fabricated new hard parent cgroup. This demonstrates bounded native delegation at initialization/retirement scope only; no image, container workload, export, bake, registration, first consumer or economic saving was established.

Preserve original outcomes separately from cleared current metadata and later helper execution. Old initialization and both failed cleanup originals remain failed/Unknown. The later old guard stop RPC returned zero while its actual stop-post helper exited3 and the manager retained a failed/exit-code result, with no current process/group or installed file. That is a terminal current remnant disposition, not a successful historical finalizer or recovered unavailable birth. Stop transport success, service outcome, actual process birth and physical retirement are separate observations. Private raw evidence remains in owner custody; Atlas records the reusable boundary, not runtime assets.

Prepare reviewed callers before minting their original. The public no-send outcome https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6402501888 consumed its original during source construction: the first guard refused before any root call and custody was late, not a capability failure. Changed source https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6402727302 prepares first, mints clocks inside invocation, preserves errors and observation-only finalization, and checks an absolute outer start gate before privileged inputs. Relative timeouts alone permit queued commands to start late. This selects no retry or clock renewal and establishes no actual execution/retirement.
